ordered_rules: ramp-up: quarter means strictly increasing and q4 >= 2.0 * max(q1, 1.0)
ramp-down: quarter means strictly decreasing and q1 >= 2.0 * max(q4, 1.0)
periodic: some lag in [3, n/2] minutes has a local ACF peak >= 0.5 and a smaller lag has ACF <= that peak - 0.3
spike: with m = max(median, 1.0), peak >= 3.0 m, exactly one contiguous run of minutes above 2m, and at most 0.15 of minutes above 2m
regime-switch: the best single change point (each side >= n/8 minutes, earliest on ties) explains >= 0.6 of the variance and the segment-mean ratio (low floored at 1.0 rps) is >= 2.0
traffic_shape.resolution: one-minute means of consecutive 30 s tick pairs (60 samples)
